pr_title: fix(test runner): do not reuse worker that did not teardown scopes
pr_body:
Two bug fixes:
- Do not use the worker that is being shutdown for a new job.
- Report unhandled errors during "expected to fail" tests as fatal errors.

Fixes #9854.

issue_context.title: [BUG] Did not tear down test scope

review_comments: Why not to treat unhandled error as fatal at all times?

To support the quite common pattern of `expect`'ing in the event handler, something along these lines:

```js
page.on('response', r => expect(r.ok()));
```
